description: This file exports two asynchronous functions, 'uploadFile' and 'downloadFile', for handling file upload and download processes via a given 'fileService' and other parameters. It facilitates chunked uploading of files and incremental download building.

methods.name: uploadFile(fileService, buffer, name, ext, chunkSize)
methods.description: Uploads a file in chunks, handling errors during chunk transfer, and finalizes the upload.

methods.name: downloadFile(fileService, itemManager, remoteIdentifier)
methods.description: Downloads a file by its remote identifier, incrementally concatenating decrypted bytes into a Uint8Array.

ctags.name: uploadFile
ctags.pattern: /^export async function uploadFile(fileService, buffer, name, ext, chunkSize) {$/
